item.title: Pretty interior! Unpainted woodwork! Circa 1912 in Tennessee. $229,900
item.description: This house has a pretty interior! Love the unpainted woodwork and the ceiling medallions! The historic Hightower Craig House was built in 1912. It is located on .51 acre in Ripley, Tennessee. The house features a covered front porch, a porte cochere, wood floors, crown moulding, baseboards, pocket doors, bay windows, built-in china cabinet, chair rails, ceiling medallions, vintage light fixtures and a spacious kitchen. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,652 square feet. $229,900 Contact Leigh

item.title: Pretty! The Thomas Walter Long House, Circa 1882 in North Carolina. $220,000
item.description: This is a pretty house! Big backyard! The house is known as the Thomas Walter Long House. It was built in 1882. It is located on .38 acre in Catawba, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, nice staircase, original wood flooring, bead board wainscoting, baseboards, crown moulding, Eastlake style mantel, picture rails and french doors. The property has a fenced in backyard. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,439 square feet. $220,000 Contact Tori Cearlock with Three and Company:

item.title: Five acres in Virginia. Big laundry room! C. 1940. $249,000
item.description: This house has some nice acreage and that is a big laundry room! The house was built in 1940. It is located on five acres in Indian Valley, Virginia. The house features a small covered front porch, original wood floors, brick and stone hearth, two skylights, spacious kitchen and a large laundry room. There is a screened in back porch and a basement. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,502 square feet. $249,000 Contact Deb Wildman with Blue Ridge Land and Auction Company: 540-230-2563 From the Zi

item.description: I love the kitchen sink in this house! The screened in porch is nice too! There is a greenhouse on the property. The house was built in 1884. It is located on .50 acre in Palestine, Texas. The house features a covered front porch, jib windows, wood floors, crown moulding, wide baseboards, transom windows, chair rails and a lot of natural light. item.title: Pretty setting! Log cabin on one acre in Vermont. $175,000
item.description: Love the setting for this cabin! It looks like it would be cozy. The cabin was built in 1930. It is located on one acre in Arlington, Vermont. The cabin features a small covered front porch, wood floors, vaulted ceiling, exposed log walls, stone fireplace and a loft area. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 684 square feet. $175,000 Contact Margretta Fischer with Wohler Realty Group: 802-297-3333 From the Zillow listing: Cozy cabin retreat waiting for you! item.title: This is cute! Former schoolhouse! C. 1831. Over an acre in North Carolina. $180,000
item.description: This is cute! I love how there are names etched in the stairs! A lot of history with this property. This was originally a school that was built in 1831. It is located on 1.48 acres in Roper, North Carolina. This is about an hour to Nags Head, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, baseboards, bead board, crown moulding and a large covered back porch. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 2,140 square feet. $180,000 Contact Robin Hope Medlin with John Vesco: 252-422-085

item.title: Nice interior! Being sold furnished! Has a pool and pool house. On 1 1/2 acres in Virginia. $625,000
item.description: Nice interior! I love the ceilings inside this home! The house is being sold fully furnished and most recently was a short term rental. The house was built in 1900. It is located on 1.5 acres in Toms Brook, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, vaulted ceiling, exposed beams, wood floors, wainscoting, brick fireplace, baseboards, spacious kitchen and some exposed log walls. item.description: This house has some pretty chandeliers! There is a guest apartment over the garage. The house was built in 1940. It is located on one acre in Welch, West Virginia. The house features a covered side porch, wood floors, baseboards, nice staircase, chair rails, crystal chandeliers, wainscoting and built-in corner cabinets. item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! Ten acres in Wisconsin. $195,000
item.description: Fixer upper alert! The setting looks nice. The house was built in 1910. It is located on ten acres in Merrill, Wisconsin. item.title: Love the vintage bathroom! Diamond in the Rough in Alabama. $125,000
item.description: I am in love with that vintage bathroom! I want it! This house looks like a diamond in the rough to me! It was built in 1928. It is located on .37 acre in Birmingham, Alabama. The house features mature landscaping, a covered front porch, wood floors, arched entryway, crown moulding, baseboards, vintage bathroom and a spacious kitchen.
